lines.arabic: فَعَلَ / يَفْعَلُ - Pattern: Past 'a', Present 'a' (U-AAA-U)
lines.translation: Example: سَلَمَ / يَسْلَمُ (to be safe). Ism fa'il: مُسْلِم, Ism maf'ool: مُسْلَم

lines.arabic: فَعَلَ / يَفْعِلُ - Pattern: Past 'a', Present 'i' (UUU-I-A)
lines.translation: Example: عَلِمَ / يَعْلَمُ (to know). Ism fa'il: مُعْلِم, Ism maf'ool: مُعْلَم

lines.arabic: فَعُلَ / يَفْعُلُ - Pattern: Past 'u', Present 'u' (U-AAA-U)
lines.translation: Example: جَهُدَ / يَجْهُدُ (to strive). Ism fa'il: مُجْهِد, Ism maf'ool: مُجْهَد

lines.arabic: فَعَّلَ / يُفَعِّلُ - Shadda on second letter (تَفْعِيل)
lines.translation: Example: عَلَّمَ / يُعَلِّمُ (to teach). Ism fa'il: مُعَلِّم, Ism maf'ool: مُعَلَّم

lines.arabic: فَاعَلَ / يُفَاعِلُ - Alif after first letter (مُفَاعَلَة)
lines.translation: Example: سَأَلَ / يُسَائِلُ (to ask). Ism fa'il: مُسَائِل, Ism maf'ool: مَسْئُول

lines.arabic: أَفْعَلَ / يُفْعِلُ - Hamza at start, present has kasra (إفْعَال)
lines.translation: Example: أَقْبَلَ / يُقْبِلُ (to approach). Ism fa'il: مُقْبِل, Ism maf'ool: مُقْبَل

lines.arabic: أَفْعَلَ / يُفْعَلُ - Hamza at start, present has fatha (إفْعَال)
lines.translation: Example: أَنْقَذَ / يُنْقَذُ (to save). Ism fa'il: مُنْقِذ, Ism maf'ool: مُنْقَذ

lines.arabic: اسْتَفْعَلَ / يَسْتَفْعِلُ - Istif'aal pattern (اسْتِفْعَال)
lines.translation: Example: اسْتَغْفَرَ / يَسْتَغْفِرُ (to seek forgiveness). Ism fa'il: مُسْتَغْفِر

lines.arabic: فَعَلَ / يَفْعُلُ - Light pattern (خَفَّفَ) - sukoon on second
lines.translation: Example: رَصَنَ / يَرْصُنُ (to anchor). Ism fa'il: رَاصِن, Ism maf'ool: مَرْصُون

lines.arabic: فَعَلَ / يَفْعِلُ - Light pattern (حَفِظَ) - kasra on second
lines.translation: Example: حَفِظَ / يَحْفِظُ (to protect). Ism fa'il: حَافِظ, Ism maf'ool: مَحْفُوظ

lines.arabic: فَعِلَ / يَفْعَلُ - Kasra in past, fatha in present
lines.translation: Example: بَرِضَ / يَبْرَضُ. Ism fa'il: بَارِض, Ism maf'ool: مَبْرُوض

lines.arabic: فَعِلَ / يَفْعَلُ - Pattern: عَمِسَ / يَعْمَسُ (dry up)
lines.translation: Ism fa'il: عَامِس, Ism maf'ool: مَعْمُوس. This is a rare pattern

lines.arabic: فَعُلَ / يَفْعُلُ - Pattern: بَسَحَ / يَبْسَحُ (to wash away)
lines.translation: Ism fa'il: بَاسِح, Ism maf'ool: مَبْسُوح. Rare intransitive pattern

lines.arabic: فَعُلَ / يَفْعُلُ - Pattern: كَرُمَ / يَكْرُمُ (to be generous)
lines.translation: Ism fa'il: كَرِيم, Ism maf'ool: مَكْرُوم. Color/defect pattern (صِفَة مُشْبِهَة)

lines.arabic: أَمْر (Command) - Drop the ي from present tense
lines.translation: افْعَلْ (Do!) - from يَفْعَلُ. اُكْتُبْ (Write!) - from يَكْتُبُ. اُدْخُلْ (Enter!) - from يَدْخُلُ

lines.arabic: نَهْي (Forbidding) - لَا + present jussive (سُكُون)
lines.translation: لا تَفْعَلْ (Don't do!) - لَا + تَفْعَلْ. لا تَكْتُبْ (Don't write!) - لَا + تَكْتُبْ

lines.arabic: مَصْدَر (Verbal Noun/Idea) - The abstract concept
lines.translation: فِعْلٌ (doing), فَاعِلٌ (doer), مَفْعُولٌ (done-to). Example: كِتَابَة (writing), قِرَاءَة (reading)

lines.arabic: زَمَان وَمَكَان (Time & Place) - مَفْعَل / مَفْعِل
lines.translation: مَفْعَل: مَسْجِد (place of sujood), مَقْبَرَة (cemetery). مَفْعِل: مَلْعَب (playground), مَشْرَب (drinking place)

lines.arabic: Form I: فَعَلَ / يَفْعَلُ - The base/root meaning
lines.translation: Example: كَتَبَ / يَكْتُبُ (to write). This is where all verbs start

lines.arabic: Form II: فَعَّلَ / يُفَعِّلُ - Intensive or transitive
lines.translation: Example: كَسَّرَ (to smash) from كَسَرَ (to break). Makes intransitive → transitive

lines.arabic: Form III: فَاعَلَ / يُفَاعِلُ - Mutual/reciprocal action
lines.translation: Example: كَاتَبَ (to correspond) from كَتَبَ (to write). Mutual action between two

lines.arabic: Form IV: أَفْعَلَ / يُفْعِلُ - Causative (make someone do)
lines.translation: Example: أَخْرَجَ (to bring out) from خَرَجَ (to exit). Causes the action in another

lines.arabic: Form V: تَفَعَّلَ / يَتَفَعَّلُ - Reflexive of Form II
lines.translation: Example: تَعَلَّمَ (to learn) from عَلَّمَ (to teach). Self-benefiting action

lines.arabic: Form VI: تَفَاعَلَ / يَتَفَاعَلُ - Reflexive of Form III
lines.translation: Example: تَكَاتَبَ (to exchange letters). Mutual action done by oneself

lines.arabic: Form VII: انْفَعَلَ / يَنْفَعِلُ - Passive/reflexive of Form I
lines.translation: Example: انْكَسَرَ (to become broken). Intransitive, happens to oneself

lines.arabic: Form VIII: افْتَعَلَ / يَفْتَعِلُ - Self-directed action
lines.translation: Example: اِفْتَحَرَ (to dig for oneself). Direct benefit to oneself

lines.arabic: Form IX: افْعَلَّ / يَفْعَلُّ - Color/defect (rare)
lines.translation: Example: احْمَرَّ / يَحْمَرُّ (to become red). Only for colors and defects

lines.arabic: Form X: اسْتَفْعَلَ / يَسْتَفْعِلُ - Seek/request
lines.translation: Example: اسْتَعْلَمَ (to ask for information) from عَلِمَ (to know). Seeking the action
